title: What deep learning can and cannot (yet) do for enzyme design.
authors: Ahr, Judith A; de Waal, Moor M; Cotet, Tudor-Stefan; Howell, Daniel C; Bunzel, H Adrian
one_liner_zh: 该文综述了深度学习在基于结构的酶设计中的进展与局限，聚焦扩散模型生成支架和序列设计，虽为综述且方法创新有限，但紧密围绕蛋白质结构计算设计问题，对课题有参考价值。
abstract: Deep learning has substantially advanced structure-based enzyme design, yet reliably creating highly efficient enzymes remains out of reach. One emerging enzyme design strategy combines diffusion-based scaffold generation around active-site models with sequence design. Such structure-based approaches have expanded the accessible reaction space and enabled the emergence of enzymes with diverse catalytic functions and complex catalytic motifs. Despite notable catalytic efficiencies (k(cat)/K(M)), turnover rates (k(cat)) often remain limited, suggesting that current approaches typically yield tight substrate binders rather than enzymes that selectively stabilize the chemical transition state. Computational design of electrostatic catalysis, multistate behavior, and conformational dynamics could potentially enhance transition-state stabilization and improve catalytic activity. More reliable activity oracles, integration of evolutionary information, protein language models, and lab-in-the-loop optimization could further enhance design performance. Ultimately, advancing structure-based enzyme design will require directly targeting the physicochemical drivers of catalysis to move beyond substrate binding toward the reliable design of efficient catalysts.
abstract_zh: 深度学习已大幅推进了基于结构的酶设计，但可靠地创造高效酶仍难以实现。一种新兴的酶设计策略将基于扩散的支架生成与活性位点模型及序列设计相结合。此类基于结构的方法扩展了可及的反应空间，并促成了具有多样催化功能和复杂催化基序的酶的出现。尽管催化效率（k(cat)/K(M)）显著，但周转率（k(cat)）往往仍受限，这表明当前方法通常产生紧密底物结合体，而非选择性稳定化学过渡态的酶。静电催化、多态行为和构象动力学的计算设计可能增强过渡态稳定化并提升催化活性。更可靠的活性预测器、进化信息的整合、蛋白质语言模型及实验室闭环优化可进一步提升设计性能。最终，推进基于结构的酶设计需直接针对催化的物理化学驱动因素，以超越底物结合，迈向高效催化剂的可靠设计。
